results.title: Indonesia Stock Exchange to Launch Short Selling Mechanism on October 1
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) will implement a short selling trading mechanism starting Thursday, October 1, allowing investors to sell borrowed shares and buy them back at lower prices for profit. Under BEI announcement No.Peng-00178/BEI.POP/09-2026, five stocks are eligible: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA), PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI), and PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk (INDF). Two exchange members, Semesta Indovest Sekuritas and Ajaib Sekuritas, are authorized to provide short selling services. Under POJK Number 6 of 2024, eligible investors must have a minimum initial capital of Rp 50 million and have held a regular securities account for at least six months, as BEI Director Jeffrey Hendrik cautioned that the mechanism carries high risk and is intended for experienced investors.

results.title: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk (IPCC) to sell vehicle terminal management rights to PT Maspion Industrial Estate for Rp13.78 billion
results.body: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk (IPCC) has ended its joint operation (KSO) with Grup Maspion over the management of a vehicle terminal in Gresik. IPCC and PT Maspion Industrial Estate signed a cooperation termination agreement and a sale and purchase binding agreement (PPJB) on Wednesday (30/9), under which IPCC will sell its management rights in the entity Manajemen Kerja Sama Maspion Terminal Kendaraan Indonesia (MKO MTKI), in which it holds a 45% stake since 2015. The agreed transaction value is Rp13.78 billion, subject to conditions to be met by both parties; MKO MTKI had assets of Rp3.46 billion as of the end of the first half of 2026. Maspion Industrial Estate, the developer of the Maspion Industrial Estate and owned by Grup Maspion of Alim Markus, holds a landbank of 1,143 hectares, about one-third of the landbank of Grup AKR's Java Integrated Industrial & Port Estate (JIIPE).

results.title: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR) to Pay Interim Dividend of Rp297 per Share
results.body: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR), an art graphic group company of Astra, will distribute an interim dividend of Rp297 per share from fiscal year 2026 profit and part of retained earnings, approved by its Board of Commissioners on 25 September 2026. Cum dividend in the regular and negotiation markets falls on 7 October 2026, ex dividend on 8 October 2026, cum dividend in the cash market on 9 October 2026, ex dividend on 12 October 2026, with the recording date on 9 October 2026 and payment on 26 October 2026. The dividend announcement follows Astra Graphia posting consolidated net profit of Rp138.45 billion in the first half of 2026, up 30.37% year-on-year from Rp106.20 billion in the same period of 2025.

results.title: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR) Announces Jumbo Interim Dividend of Rp297 Per Share, Yielding Nearly 4x Deposit Rates
results.body: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR), a subsidiary of Astra Group, will distribute an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 totaling Rp400.05 billion, or Rp297 per share, with payment scheduled for 26 October 2026 and ex-dividend dates of 8 October 2026 (regular and negotiation markets) and 12 October 2026 (cash market). The dividend implies a yield of about 13.38% based on the 29 September 2026 close of Rp2,220, or 11.74% at Rp2,530 after the stock rose 13.96% on 30 September 2026, nearly 4x Bank BCA's deposit rate of 2.7%-3%. The payout is supported by first-half 2026 net profit of Rp138.45 billion, up 30.37% year-on-year, net revenue of Rp1.56 trillion, cash of Rp1.68 trillion, and unrestricted retained earnings of Rp1.72 trillion as of 30 June 2026. PT Astra International Tbk (ASII), ASGR's main shareholder with about 76.87% ownership, stands to receive approximately Rp307.52 billion of the interim dividend.

results.title: Djarum Group Issuer PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) Seen Near Turning Point with Up to 50% Upside
results.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analysts recommend PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR), a Djarum Group issuer, with potential share price upside of up to 50% as most site churn risk from the merger of PT XL Smart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL) has been contained. Under the agreement with EXCL, TOWR retains the operator's leased tower locations without churn, contract tenor was extended to 12 years from about seven years, and effective monthly lease rates fell 7.5% versus 2025. Net collocation declined only 552 between Q2-2025 and Q2-2026, less than 10% of estimated overlapping EXCL locations in TOWR's portfolio. BRI Danareksa also sees the 5G investment cycle as a next catalyst, noting TOWR's tower fiberization reached 67% in H1-2026, above the Indonesian peer average of 50%-60% but below Thailand's 90% and Malaysia's 80%.

results.title: Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Insider Samuel International Reports Shareholding Change
results.body: On 2026-09-22, Samuel International, an insider of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera (NSSS.JK), transferred 534,176,500 shares to the company under a share‑loan arrangement. The transaction, recorded at IDR 0, increased the insider’s holding from 3,071,055,500 shares (12.90%) to 3,605,232,000 shares, raising ownership to 15.14%, an increase of 2.24 percentage points.

results.title: Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Insider Samuel International Reports Shareholding Change
results.body: On 18 September 2026, Samuel International, an insider of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera (NSSS.JK), returned 534,176,500 shares to the company as repayment of a share loan, reducing its stake from 3,605,232,000 shares (15.14% of outstanding) to 3,071,055,500 shares (12.90%). The transaction was recorded at no monetary consideration.

results.title: Telkom (TLKM) Nears Completion of Rp49.9 Trillion InfraCo Spin-Off to InfraNexia
results.body: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) is one step away from completing the Rp49.9 trillion spin-off of its fiber network business, pending shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting on Wednesday (30/9/2026). The InfraCo Phase 2 transaction will transfer part of TLKM's wholesale fiber connectivity segment to its subsidiary, PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (InfraNexia), following the first phase that took effect in January 2026. After the spin-off, InfraNexia, which is more than 99% owned by Telkom, will manage over 90% of Telkom's network infrastructure assets, including customer access networks, core backbone, and more than 112,000 kilometers of fiber optic network including 26,000 kilometers of domestic submarine cable systems. The move supports TLKM's transformation as a strategic holding company, unlocking value in assets such as data centers, telecom towers, and fiber optic networks, while InfraNexia will operate independently and neutrally to serve wholesale customers, ISPs, and mobile operators.

results.title: Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Insider Samuel International Reports Shareholding Change
results.body: On September 3, 2026, Samuel International increased its stake in Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera by 80,623,600 shares through a share‑loan arrangement, raising its holding from 3,524,608,400 shares (14.81%) to 3,605,232,000 shares (15.14%). The transaction involved no cash consideration (IDR 0) and boosted ownership by 0.33 percentage points.

results.title: Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Insider Samuel Tumbuh Bersama Reports Shareholding Change
results.body: On 29 September 2026, insider Samuel Tumbuh Bersama transferred 745,000,000 shares of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera, reducing his stake from 1,782,209,400 shares (7.49% of issued capital) to 1,037,209,400 shares (4.36%). The share loan involved no cash consideration, resulting in a transaction value of IDR 0.

results.title: Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Insider Samuel Tumbuh Bersama Reports Shareholding Change
results.body: On September 28, 2026, insider Samuel Tumbuh Bersama transferred 2,073,463,700 shares of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera in a stock‑loan arrangement, reducing his stake from 3,855,673,100 shares (16.20% ownership) to 1,782,209,400 shares (7.49% ownership). The transaction was recorded at no cash consideration (IDR 0), decreasing his ownership by 8.71 percentage points.

results.title: Telecom Infrastructure Firm Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) of Djarum Group Launches Rp500 Billion Share Buyback
results.body: Telecommunications infrastructure company PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR), part of the Djarum Group, announced a share buyback of up to Rp500 billion funded from internal cash, covering a maximum of 2% of issued and paid-up capital, or about 1,183,151,916 shares. The buyback price is estimated at Rp422.6 per share, 4.6% above the Rp404 closing price at the end of the first trading session on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, and will be executed by PT BCA Sekuritas over an effective period of three months until December 30, 2026. Management said the buyback aims to maintain share price stability and enable a more efficient capital structure, with EPS expected to rise from Rp31.91 to Rp32.57 while equity and assets decline by Rp500 billion. As of end-August 2026, Djarum Group entity PT Sapta Adhikari Investama holds 45.29% of TOWR, followed by PT Dwimuria Investama Andalan with 19.95%, PT Lingkarmulia Indah with 5.33%, the public with 27.4%, and treasury shares of 1.16%.

results.title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) Prepares Rights Issue of Up to 6.8 Billion Shares, Targeting Completion in Q1 2027
results.body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) plans to raise capital through a rights issue under its Second Pre-emptive Rights Offering (PMHMETD II), issuing up to 6.8 billion Series B shares with a nominal value of Rp500 per share, totaling up to Rp3.4 trillion in nominal value. Shareholder approval will be sought at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for 6 November 2026, with the exercise price and final share count to be set in the prospectus. Proceeds, net of issuance costs, will fund financing distribution to support business growth, with projected capital rising to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 and the capital adequacy ratio increasing to 23.31% from 20.38%. Shareholders who do not exercise their rights face potential dilution of up to 12.85%, and the company targets completing the rights issue in the first quarter of 2027, subject to OJK approval of its registration statement.

results.title: DSSA's Subsidiary PT Inti Mas Bangun Sejahtera Becomes New Controlling Shareholder of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR)
results.body: PT Inti Mas Bangun Sejahtera (IMBS), a subsidiary of PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA), completed a voluntary tender offer to take control of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR), closing on September 28, 2026. IMBS acquired 994.44 million KETR shares at Rp523 per share, valuing the transaction at Rp520.8 billion and giving it roughly 35% of KETR's fully paid-up shares. IMBS has no plans to change KETR's business direction as a telecommunications network infrastructure provider or to take the company private. KETR shares rose 89.32% over the past three months amid the takeover by the Sinar Mas group, trading at Rp975 per share on Wednesday (30/9/2026). Previously, Fajar Sejahtera Mandiri Nusantara was KETR's controlling shareholder with 1.61 billion shares, or 56.53%.

results.title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) Plans Rights Issue of Up to 6.8 Billion Series B Shares
results.body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) plans a rights issue (PMHMETD II) of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares with a nominal value of Rp500 per share, to be listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). Shareholders will be asked to approve the plan at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for 6 November 2026, with the final number of shares and exercise price to be set in the prospectus; the action is expected to be completed in Q1 2027 after OJK effectiveness. All proceeds, net of issuance costs, will be used for financing distribution to support business growth, with capital projected to rise to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 and the capital adequacy ratio projected to increase to 23.31% from 20.38%. Shareholders who do not exercise their rights will face dilution of up to 12.85%.

results.title: Djarum Group Subsidiary PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) Launches Rp500 Billion Share Buyback
results.body: PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR), a subsidiary of Djarum Group, announced a share buyback plan worth up to Rp500 billion, excluding transaction fees, intermediary commissions, and other related costs. The buyback covers approximately 2% of the company's issued and paid-up capital, equivalent to around 1,183,151,916 shares. The program runs for three months from September 30, 2026 to December 30, 2026, without requiring shareholder meeting approval, under OJK Letter No. S-112/D.04/2026 and POJK No. 13/2023 following significantly fluctuating market conditions. TOWR appointed PT BCA Sekuritas to execute the repurchases during the period.

results.title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and Subsidiaries Extend Loans of up to Rp 6.5 Trillion to Gold Refining Subsidiary PT Pani Industri Nusantara
results.body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS), together with its subsidiaries PT Gorontalo Sejahtera Mining (GSM) and PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera (PETS), will provide loans totaling up to Rp 6.5 trillion to PT Pani Industri Nusantara (PIN), a subsidiary of EMAS engaged in gold refining and smelting of precious metals. EMAS will lend up to Rp 3.05 trillion, while GSM and PETS will each lend up to Rp 1.7 trillion. The loans carry an interest rate of INDONIA plus a 1.7% margin per year, with a term until December 31, 2031, extendable. Each transaction is material as it exceeds 20% of the company's equity, and the funds are intended to support PIN's general corporate needs, including capital expenditure, operating expenses, and working capital.

results.title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) Shares Hit Auto Reject Bottom as Buying Interest Builds
results.body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) shares fell 13.51% to Rp 32, hitting Auto Reject Bottom (ARB) in the first trading session on Wednesday (30/9/2026), amid rising trading volume and a net buy of Rp 22.7 billion following the exchange's lowering of the minimum price band from Rp 50 to Rp 1. Kiwoom Sekuritas analyst Abdul Azis described the activity as a price discovery process, noting the company's improving fundamentals with net profits of Rp 171 billion in Q1-2026 and Rp 252 billion in Q2-2026, Q2 net revenue up 31% year-on-year to Rp 5.7 trillion, and adjusted EBITDA surpassing Rp 1 trillion toward a full-year target of Rp 3.2-3.4 trillion. GOTO also has a buyback budget of up to Rp 3.5 trillion, and plans to cancel around 32 billion treasury shares, to be voted on at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on 14 October 2026.

results.title: PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) Announces Share Buyback Plan of Up to Rp 500 Billion
results.body: PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR), a Djarum Group issuer, announced a share buyback plan under OJK Regulation No. 13 of 2023, with an estimated cost of up to Rp 500 billion excluding transaction fees. The buyback period is estimated for 30 September 2026 to 30 December 2026, covering around 2% of the company's issued and paid-up capital, or approximately 1,183,151,916 shares. TOWR shares rose 3.06% to Rp 404 at the end of the first trading session on Wednesday (30/9/2026), though the stock is down 30.94% year-to-date, with a PBV of 0.83x and an annualized PER of 6.40x. In the first half of 2026, TOWR booked revenue of Rp 7.2 trillion and net profit attributable to owners of the parent entity of Rp 1.85 trillion.

results.title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) Could Reach Rp 1 in Four Weeks if It Keeps Hitting Auto Reject Bottom (ARB)
results.body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) would need about 19 trading days, or four weeks, to fall to Rp 1 if it continues hitting the daily Auto Reject Bottom (ARB) each day, according to Kiwoom Sekuritas Head of Research Liza Camelia Suryanata. The stock fell 13.5% to Rp 32 on Wednesday, marking its third consecutive ARB day and a 36% decline from Rp 50. Sell queues were heavily unmatched: about 1 billion lots queued at Rp 43 on September 28 with only 1.2 million lots transacted, and 842 million lots queued at Rp 37 on September 29 with only 1.8 million lots transacted. Assuming 1.5-2 million lots trade daily, only about 31.5-41 million lots would change hands on the way to Rp 1, roughly 3-4% of the initial sell queue, which Liza said reflects one-way liquidation rather than healthy price discovery.

results.title: CMNP posts Rp2.93 trillion revenue in H1 2026, net profit falls 25.86%
results.body: CMNP, a toll road operator under the control of Mohamad Jusuf Hamka, booked revenue of Rp2.93 trillion in the first half of 2026, up 33.47% year-on-year from Rp2.20 trillion. However, cost of revenue rose more than 55% to Rp1.91 trillion, driven by a near doubling of toll road operator construction costs to Rp1.21 trillion, a more than 50% rise in construction service costs to Rp377 billion, and a roughly 25% increase in employee salaries and welfare costs to Rp100.22 billion. As a result, net profit fell 25.86% year-on-year to Rp455.03 billion from Rp613.67 billion, with earnings per share declining to Rp70 from Rp102. Based on the closing share price of Rp1,415 on Tuesday (29/9), the annualized price-to-earnings ratio stood at 10.52 times, below the infrastructure sector average of 15.34 times. Jusuf Hamka owns 4.04% of CMNP directly and 59.35% through BP2S SG/BNP Paribas Wealth Management Singapore Branch.

results.title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) Plans Rights Issue Phase II, Issuing Up to 6.8 Billion Series B Shares
results.body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) plans to raise capital through a rights issue (HMETD) phase II, issuing up to 6.8 billion Series B shares with a nominal value of Rp500 per share. The proceeds, net of issuance costs, will be used entirely for financing distribution to support the company's business growth. The capital strengthening is projected to lift the bank's capital from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 and raise its capital adequacy ratio (CAR) from 20.38% to 23.31%, while shareholders who do not exercise their rights face dilution of up to 12.85%. The plan requires shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for Friday, 6 November 2026, with the corporate action targeted for completion in the first quarter of 2027 through cash payment.

results.title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) targets capital injection via rights issue, with dilution risk of up to 20.38%
results.body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BRIS) plans a rights issue (PMHMETD) by issuing 6.8 billion new shares at a nominal value of Rp500 per share, equal to 14.74% of its 46.12 billion shares outstanding, with the exercise price not yet set. All proceeds will be channeled into credit distribution to support business growth, with shareholder approval scheduled for 6 November 2026 and completion targeted for the first quarter of 2027. The capital injection is projected to raise BRIS's core-business supporting capital to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 and lift its Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) to 23.31%, though profitability ratios may dip in the short term before recovering gradually. Shareholders who do not exercise their rights face dilution of up to 12.85%, and the article notes the title's cited dilution risk of 20.38% in aggregate terms. No standby buyer has been announced; the majority of shares are held by three state-owned banks: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) with 51.47%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) with 23.24%, and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) with 15.38%.

results.title: PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR) Pushes Electric Vehicle Rental Business to Triple Production
results.body: PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR) is strengthening its electric vehicle rental business instead of relying solely on outright sales, a strategy the company expects to raise its unit production two to three times current levels. Director and Chief Financial & Risk Officer Achmad Amri Aswono Putro said the rental scheme emerged from a 3-4 year evaluation, driven by client demand from both private companies and state-owned enterprises seeking to spend only operating expenditure (opex) on vehicle rental. The heavy assets for the rental business will be run by PT Sarana Ekomobilitas Indonesia (SEI), VKTR's subsidiary in used car wholesale trading and motor vehicle rental, which the company believes will stimulate electric vehicle electrification in Indonesia. VKTR is conducting a rights issue to inject Rp2 trillion into SEI, covering several years and to be combined with external funding, after projecting the total addressable, serviceable, and obtainable markets in Indonesia. Amri made the remarks at the 'Emiten Corner VKTR' event hosted by PT Reliance Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk on Tuesday (29/9/2026).

results.title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk (CDIA) Enters Cum Dividend Period for Interim Dividend of Up to USD10 Million
results.body: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk (CDIA), a company under Prajogo Pangestu's Barito Group, began its cum dividend period for an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 on 30 September 2026. The dividend totals a minimum and maximum of USD10 million, equivalent to Rp179.9 billion at an exchange rate of Rp17,998, or Rp1,422181 per share, based on H1 2026 net profit of USD17.2 million. CDIA also holds unrestricted retained earnings of USD98.8 million and total equity of USD1.1 billion. The ex-dividend date in the regular and negotiation markets is 1 October 2026, with recording date on 2 October 2026 and payment scheduled for 22 October 2026. On 30 September, CDIA shares rose 1.77 percent, or 10 points, to 575.

results.title: PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR) Announces New Controlling Shareholder After 35% Stake Acquisition
results.body: PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR) announced a change of control following a voluntary tender offer by PT Inti Mas Bangun Sejahtera (IMBS). IMBS acquired 994,442,000 shares, equal to 35% of all issued and fully paid shares, becoming the new controlling shareholder. Control shifted from the previous indirect controller, PT Bahtera Bintang Nusantara (BBN), through PT Fajar Sejahtera Mandiri Nusantara (FSMN), to IMBS. Management stated there is no affiliation between BBN and IMBS and that the change has no negative impact on the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

results.title: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR) to Pay Interim Dividend of Rp 297 per Share
results.body: PT Astra Graphia Tbk (ASGR) announced an interim dividend for 2026 totaling Rp 400 billion, set at Rp 297 per share with a dividend yield of 13.4%. The distribution was approved through a Directors' decision on 24 September 2026 and a Board of Commissioners' decision on 25 September 2026, with payment scheduled for 26 October 2026. Cum dividend dates are 7 October 2026 in the regular and negotiation markets and 9 October 2026 in the cash market, with ex-dividend dates of 8 October and 12 October 2026, respectively. The dividend is supported by net profit attributable to the parent entity of Rp 138.4 billion as of 30 June 2026, unrestricted retained earnings of Rp 1.7 trillion, and total equity of Rp 1.9 trillion.

results.title: New ESDM Regulation Restricts Affiliate Mining Contractors, Impacted Issuers Include PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA) and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI)
results.body: A new regulation, ESDM Ministerial Decree Number 365.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2026 signed by Minister Bahlil Lahadalia on 18 September 2026, prohibits IUP and IUPK holders from using subsidiaries or affiliates as mining contractors without ministerial approval, with exceptions for government assignments such as smelter projects and domestic mineral and coal supply. Outside these exceptions, IUP and IUPK holders must use companies holding mining services business licenses (IUJP) located in regencies/cities near the mine, and contractors whose ultimate beneficial owners match the IUP or IUPK holder are banned. Analyst Chory Agung Ramdhani of BRI Danareksa Sekuritas said issuers relying on internal contractors could face higher costs and operational risks from switching to non-affiliated contractors. Impacted issuers include PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA), which owns 95% of mining services subsidiary PT Satria Bahana Sarana, and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI), which has significant mining services transactions with PT Saptaindra Sejati (SIS), a fellow subsidiary of PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO).

results.title: Dian Swastatika Sentosa Buy Shares of Ketrosden Triasmitra
results.body: On September 28, 2026, insider Dian Swastatika Sentosa bought 994,442,000 Ketrosden Triasmitra shares at IDR 523 per share, a transaction worth IDR 520,093,166,000. The purchase raises her stake from zero to 994,442,000 shares, representing 35.000% of the company's equity, and is linked to a voluntary tender offer that makes PT Inti Mas Bangun Sejahtera the new controlling shareholder of KETR.

results.title: Amid Sluggish Cigarette Sales, PT Gudang Garam Tbk (GGRM) Takes Full Control of Dhoho Kediri Airport Operations
results.body: PT Surya Dhoho Investama, a business entity owned by PT Gudang Garam Tbk (GGRM), now holds full control over Dhoho Kediri airport operations after its cooperation agreement with PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia ended, effective 31 August 2026. The Ministry of Transportation granted the independent management permit through Decree of the Director General of Air Transportation Number KP-DJPU 216 of 2026, following Surya Dhoho Investama's acquisition of the Airport Business Entity Standard Certificate (BUBU) on 19 September 2026 under a government cooperation scheme with business entities (KPBU). The move comes as GGRM's core cigarette business faces pressure, with cigarette sales volume falling 13.6% annually to 20.5 billion sticks, a deeper decline than the national industry contraction of around 6.8%. GGRM Director Heru Budiman attributed the drop to excise tax hikes since 2020 that pushed consumers toward cheaper and illegal untaxed cigarette products, prompting the company to be more cautious in raising prices.
